method: Planned modules map to existing chapter foundations but remain planned until authored, run, evaluated and reviewed. Do not infer mastery from references or counts.

modules.title: Production inference engineering
modules.intro_problem: A chat service slows under mixed long and short prompts
learning_outcomes: Estimate and benchmark serving memory and token latency
Diagnose prefill and decoding bottlenecks
interview_questions: Why does prefill differ from decoding?
How does continuous batching affect p99 latency?
How do you size a KV cache?
local_exercises: Pinned vLLM and TGI benchmark harness
modules.diagram: Timeline of queue, prefill and decoding with TTFT/ITL labels
modules.assessment: Measured-versus-estimated GPU memory and latency worksheet

modules.title: Vision models and image generation
modules.intro_problem: A receipt reader localizes the wrong price
learning_outcomes: Compute detection and grounding metrics
Explain VLM and diffusion-based generation paths
interview_questions: How do ViT patches reach a language model?
How is bounding-box IoU calculated?
Why can an image embedding mislead?
local_exercises: Synthetic IoU/mAP calculation and image patch exercise
modules.diagram: Patch embeddings to VLM and image-editing mask flow

modules.title: Vector database interoperability
modules.intro_problem: A tenant filter silently drops all eligible matches
learning_outcomes: Design a store capability contract and tenant-safe filter
Benchmark retrieval, index tuning and migration
interview_questions: Why does postfiltering top-k break tenant recall?
What does HNSW efSearch change?
When do pgvector and FAISS differ operationally?
local_exercises: Exact cosine/dot reference and provider adapter contract
modules.assessment: Recall@k and ACL invariants under an index swap

modules.title: Video understanding and multimodal systems
modules.intro_problem: A summary confuses two visually similar events
learning_outcomes: Align frame/transcript evidence to event times
Construct citation-grounded video search
interview_questions: Why does fixed frame sampling miss actions?
How is audio/video drift detected?
What does temporal grounding prove?
local_exercises: Synthetic timestamp manifest and FFmpeg sampling exercise
modules.diagram: Audio, transcript and frame timeline with clock drift
modules.assessment: Timestamp overlap and privacy negative tests

modules.title: Practical evaluation platform engineering
modules.intro_problem: A model judge agrees with its own unsupported answer
learning_outcomes: Design immutable evaluation datasets and rubrics
Compare paired runs and judge reliability
interview_questions: When should you prefer deterministic evaluation?
How do you calibrate LLM judges?
Why can groundedness look good while recall fails?
modules.diagram: Dataset, trace, human adjudication and release gate loop
modules.assessment: Judge disagreement and high-risk slice regression

modules.title: Safety, moderation, fairness and provenance
modules.intro_problem: A poisoned paragraph influences a customer-facing answer
learning_outcomes: Evaluate moderation errors and subgroup harms
Design poisoning and artifact-integrity release gates
interview_questions: Why is refusal not authorization?
How do you set moderation thresholds?
How does poisoned retrieval cross a trust boundary?
local_exercises: Synthetic bias/threshold fixtures and artifact digest tests
modules.diagram: Moderation and human review decision tree

modules.title: Advanced agent memory
modules.intro_problem: An agent recalls a superseded preference
learning_outcomes: Differentiate episodic and semantic memories
Version, isolate and delete temporal facts
interview_questions: When is a summary a memory rather than fact?
How do you revise long-term preferences?
How can cross-tenant recall happen?
local_exercises: SQLite append-only facts with revision/retrieval policies
modules.diagram: Event, consolidation, retrieval and deletion flow
modules.assessment: Preference reversal and foreign tenant rejection

modules.title: Advanced context engineering
modules.intro_problem: A summary changes denied work into a completed step
learning_outcomes: Build provenance-preserving context packets
Test compaction and cache correctness
interview_questions: Why does a long window not guarantee recall?
How can compaction invent committed effects?
Which fields invalidate cached context?

modules.title: Foundation model fine-tuning
modules.intro_problem: A fine-tuned adapter regresses rare safety cases
learning_outcomes: Compare baseline, SFT and LoRA/QLoRA
Validate training splits and adapter compatibility
interview_questions: How does response-only SFT masking work?
Where do LoRA parameters live?
Why can quantization affect merging?
local_exercises: Tiny CPU PEFT adaptation and optional GPU profile
modules.diagram: Frozen base and low-rank update computational graph
modules.assessment: Leakage, incompatible adapter and regression tests

modules.title: MCP interoperability and OAuth
modules.intro_problem: A client accepts another issuer's bearer token
learning_outcomes: Trace host/client/server permissions and version negotiation
Verify interoperable wire protocol behavior
interview_questions: Who authorizes the MCP tool call?
What changes with remote OAuth resource audiences?
When can a timeout duplicate effects?
local_exercises: Official local SDK STDIO/HTTP test and optional OAuth sandbox
modules.assessment: Version, denied scope and lost-ack cases

modules.title: Production observability and FinOps
modules.intro_problem: A retried stream charges twice despite one task outcome
learning_outcomes: Reconcile provider token usage into task costs
Define measurable SLO and budget gates
interview_questions: How can token estimates differ from billing?
How do retries affect per-user cost?
Which signals expose failing provider calls?
local_exercises: Synthetic token/price ledger, trace spans and alert calculator
modules.diagram: Task trace to cost reservation and settlement
modules.assessment: Concurrent budget overspend and missing usage

modules.title: AI framework and provider comparison labs
modules.intro_problem: A hidden framework retry duplicates a side effect
learning_outcomes: Compare SDKs and orchestration frameworks against equal contracts
Design a migratable provider/tool boundary
interview_questions: When is an SDK enough?
How do LangChain and LlamaIndex differ?
How do you compare ADK and OpenAI Agents SDK fairly?
local_exercises: Provider-neutral direct SDK and multi-framework task contract
modules.diagram: Framework layers and migration adapter boundary
modules.assessment: Denied side effect, malformed output and replay assertions
